title: The Nutcracker 2026 - December 20, 2pm
seo_title: The Nutcracker 2026 at Landers Theatre, Springfield MO
description: Springfield Ballet presents the holiday classic The Nutcracker, part of its 50th anniversary celebration, at the Historic Landers Theatre. This performance is Sunday, December 20, 2026 at 2:00 PM at 311 E Walnut St in Springfield, MO. The show runs two hours with a 20 minute intermission, and performances continue December 17-21, 2026, including a 7:00 PM show on December 20.
address: 311 E Walnut St, Springfield, MO 65806-2301, United States, Springfield, MO
